content.text: OCR this FX option expiries table. Output JSON only: {"spot":{pair:value}, "rows":[{"day":..., "date":..., "expiries":{pair:[{"strike":..., "notional":...(exactly as written, e.g. "€2.2bn"), "bold":true|false}]}}]}. Include every pair column; use an empty list for a greyed-out cell. Do not guess: if a value is unclear write "[UNCLEAR]".
